anovādaka: [Na+ovādaka] (ti) CL=8 Not listening to or obey admonishment / discipline, The person who does not listen to or obey admonishment / discipline
anovādakara: [Na+ovādakara] (ti) CL=8 The person who have not done any admonishment / disciplining -  who does not listen to or obey admonishment / discipline -
anovādakatta: [Anovādaka+tta] (na) CL=8 Not obeying the admonishment /Not following the discipline
anovādī: [Na+ovādī] (ti) CL=8 The person who does not admonish / give discipline
anoññāta: [Na+avaññāta] (ti) CL=7 That which should not be disrespected or underestimated. See – anavaññāta.
anoḷārikasabhāvatā: [Anoḷārika+sabhāva+tā] (thī) CL=8 The state of having the nature which is - not coarse - not harsh - gentle -
anoḷārikatta: [Na+oḷārikatta] (na) CL=8 The state of having the body (manner) which is not - coarse - harsh -
anoṇamaka:
[Na+oṇamaka] (ti) CL=8 The person who does not - bend - hold - the head down.
See also Anonata -(ga)-
anoṇamana: [Na+oṇamana] (na) CL=8 Not - bending down - being stingy - being persistent -
